questions.q: Why did Jim creep back up the bank instead of staying hidden under the bridge?
choices: His curiosity was stronger than his fear
He wanted to fight the pirates himself
He went back to fetch the pistol he dropped
His mother told him to go and look
questions.evidence: My curiosity, in a sense, was stronger than my fear

questions.q: Who was giving orders to the pirates who rushed the inn?
choices: The blind beggar
Black Dog
The man with the lantern
Dirk, the lookout
questions.evidence: the middle man of this trio was the blind beggar

questions.q: What was the blind man's name?
choices: Pew
Dirk
Johnny
Dance

questions.q: When Pew asks for "Flint's fist," what is he really looking for?
choices: Something written by Flint, not the money
Flint's own hand, cut off and kept
A gold ring that Flint always wore
Flint's old cutlass and pistols
questions.evidence: The blind man cursed the money.

questions.q: Whom did Pew blame when the pirates could not find what they wanted?
choices: The people of the inn, mostly the boy
Black Dog, for warning the captain
Dirk, for searching too slowly
The revenue officers on the road
questions.evidence: It's these people of the inn--it's that boy.

questions.q: What did the whistle from the hillside turn out to be?
choices: A signal warning the pirates of danger
Pew calling his crew in to attack the inn
A shepherd calling his dog on the hill
The lugger signalling from out at sea
questions.evidence: a signal to warn them of approaching danger

questions.q: Two pirates searched "half-heartedly" while the rest stood "irresolute on the road." What does "irresolute" mean?
choices: Unsure what to do
Very angry and loud
Ready to fight
Badly hurt and bleeding
questions.evidence: the rest stood irresolute on the road

questions.q: What did Pew do when his men argued that they already had the money?
choices: Struck at them with his stick
Gave up and walked off home
Offered them all a share of gold
Ran into the inn himself
questions.evidence: he struck at them right and left in his blindness

questions.q: What happened to Pew when the horses and pistol-shot frightened the pirates away?
choices: His comrades deserted him
His comrades carried him off
He hid inside the inn
He escaped on the lugger
He ran under a horse and was trampled
He was shot by one of the revenue officers
He tripped and fell off the cliff
He drowned in the cove at Kitt's Hole
questions.evidence: the four hoofs trampled and spurned him and passed by

questions.q: Who were most of the riders who arrived?
choices: Revenue officers
Pirates from the lugger
Farmers from the hamlet
Dr. Livesey's servants

questions.q: What happened when Supervisor Dance reached Kitt's Hole?
choices: The lugger was sailing off and someone shot at him
He captured the lugger and its whole crew
He found the captain's money hidden in the rocks
He found the pirates asleep on the beach
questions.evidence: a bullet whistled close by his arm

questions.q: Why did Jim want to take the packet to Dr. Livesey?
choices: He thought it was what the pirates wanted and should be kept safe
He hoped to sell it to the doctor for enough to repair the inn
The doctor had asked him to bring it over earlier in the week
He thought it held medicine the doctor could use for his mother
questions.evidence: I believe I have the thing in my breast pocket
